verdict.rationale: Sketch's docs show Symbols as reusable elements whose edits propagate to every instance, so instances stay linked to their source. They also cover Nested Symbols and Library updates via starred versions. Community users independently praise Symbols and Libraries for component-based design systems. However, the evidence never describes variants or per-instance overrides; the only nearby item is an AI feature that swaps light-mode components for dark-mode ones. Missing for 10: documented component variants, documented per-instance override behavior, and hands-on evidence that overrides survive source updates.
